answer.text: No. The manual says not to run the motorcycle while the ABS lamp stays on above 5 km/h.
Take the motorcycle to the nearest Authorised Royal Enfield Service Centre to have the brake system inspected.

policy.text: The ABS lamp should turn off once the motorcycle passes 5 km/h, and it lights up again when there is an ABS malfunction.

watchouts.text: Not getting the brake system inspected can result in serious injuries and loss of life.
Keep the instrument cluster working properly, since it is an integral part of the ABS system.

disclaimers.text: The manual does not give a waiting period before the lamp must be checked.
